column1: # K-Line Dash: Mazda manufacturer-specific trouble code meanings
#   - description: our own short wording of the Mazda meaning of a P1xxx code.
#   - note: a short first check, only where sources widely agree; empty otherwise.
# Curated selection, not an import. A code is listed only if at least two separate publications agree on
# its meaning and none disagrees. Per-code sources: docs/research/dtc-sources-more-makes.md
#   MA  Mazda code list of obd-codes.com (copied by mellens.net, icarsoft and engine-light-help.com; counted once)
#   MB  Mazda factory DTC definitions on blog.myairbags.com (differently worded rewrite of the Mazda list)
#   TC  troublecodes.net, entries labelled Mazda: https://www.troublecodes.net/p1codes/
#   KI  Kia lists of obd-codes.com and engine-light-help.com (Kia Sephia/Spectra engines use Mazda ECU codes)
# Mazda's older engines (323/Protege/MX-5/626 era) share many codes with Ford. Only codes that Mazda-specific
# publications confirm were taken; codes whose only evidence is a Ford list were left out.
